services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: For over 70 years, Camp Albemarle has been a place where children and youth step away from the noise of everyday life and experience something deeper-faith, friendship, and personal growth. On the Crystal Coast of North Carolina, campers are invited into a Christ-centered community where they try new things, build lasting relationships, and grow in confidence and character. Through outdoor adventure, meaningful mentorship, and intentional faith formation, each week of camp is designed to shape not just what campers do-but who they are becoming.
